name: Vercel design system
summary: Written breakdown of Vercel's light, monochrome design system: color, type, spacing and guidelines.
description: A reference page documenting Vercel's design system: the near-white palette (#fafafa, #ffffff, #171717), Geist Sans and Geist Mono typography with a type scale, a 4px spacing grid with 6px radii, and do/don't guidelines for color, type, radius and elevation. Its DESIGN.md can be connected to AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex.
contains: color palette: Paper White #fafafa, Pure White #ffffff, near-black #171717 surfaces, Terminal Green #297a3a accent
typography: Geist Sans for display and interface text, Geist Mono for labels, metadata and code
type scale: minor third (1.2) from a 14px base, display sizes 56-64px with tight tracking
spacing: 4px grid; 6px border radius for cards, buttons and containers
do/don't guidelines for color, type, radius, elevation and letter-spacing
DESIGN.md for AI agents, connectable to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex
